title: Backup extraction technical chain — depth 1
summary: Recursive target covering iPhone Backup Extractor, encrypted local backups, Manifest.db, and open-source extraction tooling.

unresolved: The exact backup container and historical tool version shown in 2022 remain unresolved.

notes: Current Reincubate documentation says direct iCloud-backup retrieval became unavailable as of May 2020.
This creates a concrete question whether the 2022 material was a local encrypted backup, converted iCloud backup, live account data, or another exported container.

data.research_question: Which exact backup format and extraction path best explain the 2022 screenshots and scripts?
objectives: Identify backup-format version, device metadata, encryption state, and Manifest.db schema.
Compare screenshots and APIs against historical tool versions.
Inspect Manifest.db and Manifest.plist without relying on filenames alone.
Produce deterministic extraction reports with per-file hashes and preserved domain-relative paths.
hypotheses: The distributed material was likely an exported or local backup container rather than direct retrieval of an iCloud backup in 2022.
Manifest metadata can distinguish devices, backup dates, domains, and relative paths.

workflow.next_action: Collect historical tool versions and screenshots, inspect any surviving Manifest.db and Manifest.plist, and compare their metadata to the public thread timeline.
